description:
Implement a DataFusion DataFrame adapter for BenchBox, enabling TPC-H benchmark
execution using DataFusion's Python bindings. DataFusion belongs to the Expression
family (like Polars), offering lazy evaluation, Arrow-native execution, and
competitive single-node performance.

Current State:
- BenchBox has no DataFusion integration (neither SQL nor DataFrame)
- Expression family base class exists (ExpressionFamilyAdapter)
- Polars adapter serves as reference implementation for Expression family
- TPC-H queries have dual implementations (pandas_impl, expression_impl)

Value Proposition:
- Fastest single-node Parquet engine (ClickBench 2024)
- Apache Arrow native - zero-copy data interchange
- SQL and DataFrame API in same engine
- Rust core with Python bindings - memory safe, performant
- Growing adoption (InfluxDB 3, GlareDB, OpenObserve)
